input.detail:
**Done.** Created three files:

- **`src/lib/github-issues.ts`** — mapper library with:
  - `GitHubIssue` interface covering both object and string label shapes (`GitHubLabel` union type)
  - `mapLabelsToPriority()` — word-boundary regex matching for `critical/urgent/p0/high` → `high`, `medium/normal/p1` → `medium`, `low/p2` → `low`
  - `mapStateToStatus()` — closed → `done`; labels drive `blocked`/`in_progress`; default `todo`
  - `mapIssueToTask()` — full `Task` converter; extracts project from `repository.name` with `repository_url` fallback; maps labels to tags
- **`src/lib/github-issues.test.ts`** — 43 unit tests covering all mapper functions and edge cases
- **`src/app/api/github/issues/route.ts`** — GET handler using `octokit.issues.listForAuthenticatedUser({ filter: "assigned", state: "open" })`; filters out PRs (the endpoint returns both); requires GITHUB_TOKEN

All 121 tests pass, typecheck clean.
